integrity: Proof is analytical using an exact finite Markov partition and classical chain CLT. Supplementary symbolic checks do not certify all infinite-lag claims.
limitations: Only the right plateau endpoint and zero-digit indicator; unindexed or uninspected equivalent calculations remain a priority risk. No nonstationary covariance formula is claimed.
title: Exact three-step zero-digit correlations and a Gaussian law at a golden-map plateau endpoint
